Verdict

Reviewed 20 Oct 2026 · next 18 Apr 2027

Do not use. Affected by CVE-2026-93753 (CVSS 8.7), the fix PR was closed unmerged, no release since March 2023, and npm audit does not flag it.

Current Requirement: Deep merge of nested configuration objects

Reasoning

  1. CVE-2026-93753: mergeObject() decides safety by inspecting the target instead of the key, so a __proto__ key survives when the target is a null-prototype object, contains a null/undefined placeholder, or already has an own __proto__ key. The returned object then inherits attacker-chosen data properties.
  2. Reproduced all four variants locally; merged.session.isAdmin returned true while Object.keys() and JSON.stringify() showed nothing.
  3. No fix: PR #274 was closed unmerged on 2026-09-24 and master still contains the vulnerable guard. The maintainer declined to act on issue #273.
  4. npm audit reports 0 vulnerabilities for 4.3.1 because the OSV record has only a GIT range and no npm ecosystem entry.
  5. Last release 4.3.1 in March 2023; 22 open PRs, 18 stale; no CI and no provenance.
  6. Slowest candidate at ~107k ops/s and stack-overflows on deep or cyclic input.

Caveats

  • Even a patched fork would still leave the package unmaintained. Treat it as end-of-life.
  • Migrating away is a small change: the API is merge(target, source) with an options object.

Decision context

Approved

@fastify/deepmerge is the primary choice for Deep merge of nested configuration objects. This package is classified as Dropped.

Adopt @fastify/deepmerge as the primary implementation: it is the only candidate that combines OIDC trusted publishing, SLSA provenance, zero runtime dependencies, bundled types, active maintenance and immunity to CVE-2026-93753. deepmerge-ts is approved as the fallback for cyclic inputs or Map/Set merging, at the cost of a long-lived NPM_TOKEN in its release pipeline. deepmerge is dropped because the vulnerability has no upstream fix and is invisible to npm audit. ts-deepmerge, merge-deep, lodash.merge, @corex/deepmerge, deep-extend and the CVE-fork packages are rejected; defu, merge-anything and @75lb/deep-merge remain on hold and are not approved for this requirement.
